The '''Auction Agents''' are [[NPC]]s located in the {{Zone|Dragontail Auction House}} on the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}}. They allow players to access the [[Auction House]].

== Interface ==
{{:Auction House/UI}}

== Usage ==
Right-clicking on any Auction Agent will open the [[Auction House]] menus.

== Trivia ==
* Despite the {{zone|Dragontail Auction House}} containing 2 '''Auction Agents''', {{zone|Scarleton Auction House}} contains only {{NPCSprite|Elmar}}, the Auction Master.
